title: Choose the upper-rail homepage
question: Your steer is applied: the horizontal command rail sits above the board. Choose the version that best fits Poorup.

options.label: Upper-Rail Portal
options.lineage: command rail above a centered tabletop portal
options.thesis: Put Create, Join, identity, and live facts in one upper rail, then let the board own the full stage below.
options.viewport: The rail stays visible at the top while the board scales from the remaining viewport height.
options.risk: The rail must read as one deliberate instrument, not four unrelated cards.

options.label: Upper-Rail Split
options.lineage: upper action rail with board and entry columns
options.thesis: Use the upper rail for the primary Create action and identity, then split the lower field between the board and a concise Join panel.
options.viewport: A persistent top rail owns the first action; the board and join ledger share the field below without a center void.
options.risk: The Join ledger needs a strict width cap so Create remains the obvious first move.

options.label: Upper-Rail Dispatch
options.lineage: broadcast-style rail above a live room index
options.thesis: Make the upper rail a dispatch strip for Create, Join, Rooms, and Profile, with the board and live directory below.
options.viewport: The top strip establishes the route; a wide board plate and truthful room index fill the lower stage.
options.risk: A live directory is useful only when empty and loading states are as clear as populated rows.

canonCard.label: Current composition
canonCard.thesis: Keep the existing stage and tune the spacing only.
canonCard.viewport: The current layout remains the baseline if none of the upper-rail structures fit the team.
canonCard.risk: The measured empty center and capped visual anchor remain.
